playFilter: ball_snap only on plays with isDropback TRUE or a pass_forward frame; pass_forward on every play that has one

coordinateConvention.origin: corner where the offense's own end line meets the sideline on its right
coordinateConvention.x: along the field, 0 to 120, increasing in the offense's direction of play; includes both end zones (field of play 10 to 110)
coordinateConvention.y: across the field, 0 to 53.3, increasing to the offense's left
coordinateConvention.transform: rows whose source playDirection is 'left' are rotated 180 degrees about the field centre: x' = 120 - x, y' = 53.3 - y; 'right' rows are unchanged

scope.cut: whole games in gameId order; 9 of 16 dropped
